section.name: Östa / Ingbo källor-Råsbo
section.notes: Official western continuation from the Östa/Ingbo källor area toward Råsbo. The GPX starts at Ingbo källor, about 110 m from the Ingbo parking/service cluster, while Etapp 20 also has separate Östa branches.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 20:1 GPX as primary geometry.
Do not draw a direct connector from Etapp 20's Östa camping endpoint to the 20:1 GPX start; the shared continuity is through the Ingbo källor/Östa branch area.
Keep Råsbo parking and bus as normal access facilities.
qa: Official distance 9.5 km is close to computed GPX length 9.09 km.
The 20:1 end is 26 m from the 20:2 start at Råsbo.
Etapp 20:1 was missing from generated source shards before the 2026-04-29 completeness audit.
